indicators.label: Historical hazard index (Rama Rao method)
indicators.rationale: Rama Rao et al. (2020): z-scores of drought, flood and cyclone proneness, weighted 55/25/20 (Table 5b), classed at ±0.5 and ±1.5 SD (Table 7).

indicators.label: Drought proneness
indicators.rationale: Share of years with seasonal rainfall more than 25 % below the district average (IMD meteorological drought). June–September rainfall where the monsoon brings at least half the annual total, annual rainfall otherwise.

indicators.label: Flood proneness
indicators.rationale: Area flooded at least once in satellite images 1998–2022 (NRSC/ISRO Flood Affected Area Atlas), as a share of the district's area. 0 = no flooding observed.

indicators.label: Cyclone proneness
indicators.rationale: Equal-weight average of the number of cyclonic storms and of severe cyclonic storms crossing the district, and the highest wind on those tracks, each scaled 0–1 (IMD/RSMC best tracks).
